sourceSelection: Unmodified official merged-release texture files, each matching at least one installed vanilla/version-overlay entry. Presence does not prove runtime activation, especially PBR overlays.
blockAliasWarning: Legacy stone_stairs names cobblestone stairs. stone_slab/smooth_stone use different smooth-stone textures. These presets explicitly mean normal stone.

banner.patternOrder: Exported IDs are lexical source-file names, not a claimed native Loom collection order. Native #banner_patterns/#banner_colors are backend bindings.
banner.alpha: Preserve full source alpha, including partial175/176 edges; never threshold to a binary mask.
banner.sampling: Native entity.material banner samplerIndex0 textureFilter Point. banner_pole adds DISABLE_TINTING.
banner.composition: Tint RGB multiplicatively and composite pattern layers source-over over the base cloth. This is a reconstruction pending native shader/screenshot calibration.

reconstruction.mesh: Unit-cube/slab/voxel-stair surfaces and banner cuboids reconstructed from shapes and original atlas layout; no native C++ mesh or Java model is presented as Bedrock ground truth.
reconstruction.camera: Orthographic item pose, per-face brightness and dye profiles are configurable reconstructions. Empirical native calibration and remaining residuals are recorded below; no native camera or shader recovery is claimed.
reconstruction.textureIdentityVsRenderer: Original texture hashes establish texture identity; they do not certify the complete item renderer.

calibration.capturePolicy: User-owned native lossless PNGs and original fonts remain ignored/private. No native screenshot pixels are packaged or committed.

block.fitTraining: Stone input1 only; source texture identities fixed. Stone-bricks output1 held out.
block.uv: Top rotates90degrees; sides mirrorU in world space. Stairs shape rotates90degrees and then uses the same world-aligned block UV policy.
block.fitReportDomain: 79x80 pixels: only the input crop leftmost1px slot-skin bleed column excluded, same domain reported for holdout. Independent QA separately reports complete80x80 without masks.

training.domain: 79x80 excluding only leftmost slot-skin bleed column of input crop; same domain for heldout

differentTextureHoldout.domain: 79x80 excluding only leftmost slot-skin bleed column of input crop; same domain for heldout

full80ShapeValidation.note: Native result includes quantity2 overlay; complete measurement intentionally retains it.

block.slabOcclusion: The first native slab-result capture contains quantity2 plus its black shadow in the item ROI. Full measurements retain them; that residual cannot all be assigned to block mesh/shader.
block.scalePolicy: Offsets and padding scale proportionally with raster resolution. Host-supplied custom meshes keep the generic camera defaults.
block.shapeValidationNote: The table contains counterfactual orientation candidates too. Shipping normal-stone-stairs uses90degrees with world-aligned UVs; other listed rotations are not the production preset.

cleanSlabHoldout.roiEvidence: Independent QA verified actual hotbar top border at997..1001, interior1002..1081; therefore y1002 is the full80 renderer ROI. Earlier estimated1003 included a lower white border and is not used.

bannerSelector.source: Native32 normal-pattern collection observed in lossless Loom capture, independently matched against original TGA shapes.
bannerSelector.orderEvidence: Not source JSON enumeration. Binding registry remains backend-owned; captured order includes32, correcting earlier31 count.
bannerSelector.colorFitTraining: Only border cell35x70 fitted;31 other cells held out.
bannerSelector.productionProfile: Integer namedgray[71,79,82] and namedwhite[240,240,240], matching the fitted effective colors. Regression float fit residuals are distinct from independent measurements of actual produced canvases.

bannerCloth.colorEvidence: Opaque red in native GUI is[176,46,38]. White base modulation matches[240,240,240]. Namedother14 dye profiles have not all been independently calibrated.
bannerCloth.selectionCorrection: The native filename containingstripe actually showsstripe-right; source42-mask matching confirms it, notstripe-center.
bannerCloth.noMask: All100x200 pixels retained, including leftmost native frame/renderer phase blending.

bannerItem.fitTraining: White banner input only; red-border output held out.
bannerItem.domain: 79x80; native input leftmost1px slot-skin bleed excluded; independent full-domain comparison is separate.
bannerItem.fabricEvidence: Native flat preview red is176/46/38, while3D item red edges are161..168 from original cloth shading. Item pattern shading therefore multiplies the original fabric RGB; flat GUI mode does not. Original pole/bar texture uses untinted base atlas.
bannerItem.geometry: Reconstructed20x40x1cloth,2x42x2pole,20x2x2bar. Conventional cuboid unwrapping follows original64x64 atlas; this is not a recovered native mesh.

remainingDifferences: Nearest pixel-center rasterization does not reproduce all native GPU edge coverage, shader arithmetic or filtering.
Orthographic profiles are empirically fitted approximations; native C++ matrices and mesh implementation remain unavailable.
Namedwhite/red/gray have native capture evidence; the other named dye colors remain explicit configurable Web profiles.
Only captured states and sizes have been measured; other cameras/models, GUI scales and pack stacks are not certified.
calibration.tests: 11/11 item-renderers.spec.ts browser/SSR/codec checks passed after finalstair orientation and fabric shading changes; formal /calibration.html fixture; source/decode invariants include exact independent complete RGBA hashes.
